description: Infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques (IRVE) is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de l'Agglomération Montargoise, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Agglomération Montargoise. Ces données permettent de localiser et de connaître les caractéristiques techniques des stations et des points de recharge pour véhicules électrique ouverts au public, appartenant à l'Agglomération Montargoise et implantés sur son territoire. Ces stations et points de recharges font partie du réseau E-totem (plus d’information sur le site internet e-totem.fr ). Coverage: Agglomération Montargoise (Loiret). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are IRVE, SCDL. The portal shows 20 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-agglo-montargoise-fr-portal.
